source_name: Slovenská Fintech Asociácia (SLOFIA)
why_relevant: Sector association (founded 2018) acting as a hub between fintech firms, regulators and press; its member list and communications point to the fintech actors and spokespeople whom Slovak trade media quote for payment-market numbers, and to the FinTech Hub initiative.

source_name: Profesia.sk — Slovak job board (banking / payments / ATM roles)
why_relevant: Dominant SK job portal; bank and PSP ads name card management systems, ATM fleet sizes, switch/processing platforms, migration projects (e.g. instant payments, digital euro readiness) and team structures. Weak-signal roadmap intelligence not published anywhere else.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — kariéra (NBS careers portal)
why_relevant: NBS vacancies for payment-systems, oversight, currency (cash) and statistics units signal regulator priorities: TARGET/instant payments, digital euro pilot, cash-cycle management, reporting reforms.

source_name: Združenie pre bankové karty SR (ZBK) — Slovak Bank Card Association
why_relevant: The card-industry body for SK; glossary, standards, member list and occasional card-market commentary/statistics. Also a pointer to card issuers, acquirers and processors and to their events.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — projects and standards
why_relevant: Banking association publishes positions, standards and project pages (incl. ADR institute, payment standards); a hub pointing to member banks, working groups and industry events where payment volumes are presented.

source_name: Inštitút alternatívneho riešenia sporov SBA (ARS SBA)
why_relevant: Successor to the former bank ombudsman; handles consumer disputes arising from payment services and banking transactions. Case counts/typology by product are a proxy for card fraud, disputed ATM withdrawals and payment-service friction.

source_name: NBS — ochrana finančných spotrebiteľov (financial consumer protection / complaints)
why_relevant: NBS is the single contact point for financial-consumer complaints; its consumer-protection reporting (annual supervision reports) carries complaint counts by product incl. payment accounts and cards.

source_name: Fininfo.sk (Ministerstvo financií SR) — payment services & accounts consumer portal
why_relevant: MoF consumer portal publishes submitted questions/complaints (podnety) and answers on payment services and accounts — a qualitative complaint stream, plus institutional map of where complaints go.

source_name: New Retail Summit (Blue Events, with SAMO / Zväz obchodu SR)
why_relevant: Largest SK retail conference since 2020, co-organised with the retail associations. Agendas and speaker decks frequently carry payment-mix, checkout technology, card-acceptance cost and cash-handling data for SK retail — rarely published elsewhere.

source_name: Zväz obchodu SR (Slovak Trade Association)
why_relevant: Retail employers' association; co-organiser of New Retail Summit and a lobbying voice on card acceptance costs, mandatory cashless payments and cash handling. Positions/press releases quantify merchant-side fee burden.

source_name: Slovenská aliancia moderného obchodu (SAMO)
why_relevant: Alliance of the largest modern-trade retail chains in SK; co-organiser of New Retail Summit and a lobbying actor on payment acceptance, transaction tax and cash policy. URL inferred from association name — treat as unverified.

source_name: Finweek Bratislava (financial-sector conference)
why_relevant: Annual SK finance conference covering digital euro, payment systems and banking innovation; agendas and press coverage surface figures and roadmaps. Also the venue where Zlatá minca awards are announced. Domain inferred from event name — unverified.

source_name: ITAPA — largest Slovak technology conference
why_relevant: Government/e-services technology conference; payments, digital identity, digital euro and public-sector card acceptance appear in agendas and published presentations (ITAPA historically publishes speaker decks/video).

source_name: Slovak Fintech Association — events page
why_relevant: Aggregates SK fintech/payments events and news; a discovery surface for smaller conferences, meetups and PSP actors that never appear in official statistics.

source_name: Zlatá minca — Slovak financial products award
why_relevant: Running since 2005 with ~38 product categories incl. debit and credit cards and 'most innovative bank'. Nomination lists are a near-complete annual census of card products on the SK market; jury results signal competitive positioning.

source_name: Podnikajte.sk — merchant-facing analyses of card acceptance costs and cash rules
why_relevant: Publishes concrete SK merchant cost breakdowns (terminal rental, transaction fees, surcharging legality) and tracks the mandatory-cashless / QR payment obligation timeline — quantitative merchant-side data absent from regulator statistics.

source_name: Retail magazín.sk / Tovar a predaj — SK retail trade press
why_relevant: Covers retail conferences, checkout/payment technology rollouts and association positions; often reports figures presented in conference decks that are otherwise unpublished.

source_name: LinkedIn — SK payments/ATM practitioner profiles and job posts
why_relevant: English-language complement to Profesia; profiles of SK POS/ATM vendors and PSP staff reveal system names, employers and project history (e.g. ONEPOS terminal distributors). Strong actor-mapping value.

source_name: CGI Slovensko — payment systems practice
why_relevant: IT vendor page for SK payment-systems work; vendor case studies, service descriptions and local job ads indirectly reveal which SK banks are modernising card/payment platforms.

source_name: Banky.sk — banking consumer portal (ombudsman/ADR explainers)
why_relevant: Documents the institutional history of the SK bank ombudsman and its replacement by ARS SBA — needed to interpret complaint time series and to locate archived ombudsman reports.

source_name: MH SR — Zoznam subjektov alternatívneho riešenia sporov (ADR entity register)
why_relevant: Official Ministry of Economy register of ADR bodies — authoritative list of who may handle financial/payment consumer disputes in SK, and therefore who publishes complaint statistics.

source_name: data.slovensko.sk — Národný katalóg otvorených dát (successor portal) + SPARQL endpoint
why_relevant: Successor/parallel front-end of the national catalogue exposing DCAT-AP-SK 3.0 metadata via a SPARQL endpoint — the most machine-friendly way to query the whole Slovak public-sector dataset inventory for payment/banking keywords, and to track when a distribution URL changes or disappears.

source_name: Metodika pre otvorené údaje (opendata.gov.sk Confluence) — API documentation for the national catalogue
why_relevant: Official methodology wiki documenting which machine interfaces the national catalogue offers (CKAN legacy vs DCAT-AP-SK), deprecation timelines, and publishing obligations. Essential for building a durable, non-breaking ingestion path and for knowing when an interface is being retired.

source_name: NBS OpenStats — Národná banka Slovenska interactive statistics platform
why_relevant: NBS's own filter-and-download statistics layer (dashboards on banks, loans, deposits, expanding dataset selection). The most likely future home of machine-readable NBS payment/card series; contact statdata@nbs.sk is an explicit route to bulk data requests.

source_name: Legacy www.nbs.sk URL space (pre-redesign site paths still resolving, e.g. /sk/platby/platobne-systemy/...)
source_subtype: retired site path / legacy URL space
why_relevant: The old NBS information architecture (www.nbs.sk/sk/...) still appears in search indexes alongside the new nbs.sk/... paths. Legacy paths often carry older PDF/XLS releases and are the continuity bridge to Wayback captures of retired statistics pages.

source_name: NBS SIPS payment system statistics (volume and value of transactions since 2003)
why_relevant: Continuous national retail payment system series running back to 1 January 2003 — one of the deepest Slovak payment time series available and a benchmark for detecting methodology breaks elsewhere.

source_name: NBS Výročná správa (Annual Report) PDF back-catalogue
why_relevant: Annual reports carry payment-system, cash-circulation and card chapters with figures as published each year; the /_img/documents/_publikacie/ path is a stable, predictable document store that survives front-end redesigns.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — captures of retired NBS / bank statistics pages
why_relevant: The only general-purpose surface preserving retired NBS statistics pages, discontinued card/ATM tables and pre-redesign PDF links. The CDX API allows programmatic enumeration of every capture of a URL prefix, making it the backbone of a continuity strategy for broken time series.

source_name: ECB Data Portal — Payments Statistics datasets (PCP, PMC, and successor payment datasets) via SDMX 2.1 API
why_relevant: Harmonised, SK-broken-out card payment, cash withdrawal and fraud series with a documented SDMX 2.1 REST API and CSV/XLS/SDMX downloads. The single most ingestible machine-readable source for Slovak card/ATM/POS statistics, and immune to NBS site redesigns.
